Hippe.et: From Middle High German heppe, happe, hipe, from Old High German heppa, hīpe, happa, from Proto-West Germanic *happjā. Compare Dutch heep.

Hippe.et: A regional feminine or back-formation from a diminutive of Proto-West Germanic *hafr (“billygoat”).
